name: Creative automatic-navigation prohibition
description: Prohibits redirects, forced application opens, and click hijacking without deliberate user interaction.
policy: An advertising creative must not navigate the top-level browsing context, open an application or application store, synthesize a click, or start a redirect chain unless the user deliberately interacts with a clearly presented control. Navigation caused by timers, page load, pointer movement, invisible overlays, or click interception is prohibited. A seller that detects prohibited navigation must reject the creative and identify this policy.
guidance: Test the creative before interaction and exercise each visible control. Buyer remediation: remove automatic redirects, forced-open logic, invisible click targets, and click interception; preserve navigation only after explicit user activation.

pass.scenario: A user clicks a visible Learn more button and the creative opens the disclosed advertiser landing page.
pass.explanation: Navigation follows deliberate interaction with a clearly presented control.

fail.scenario: Two seconds after rendering, a display tag replaces the publisher page with an application-store destination even though the user did not interact.
fail.explanation: The creative initiates top-level navigation without user activation.
